card.name: Adjectives before drug reaction terms
card.fires_on: The word "fixed" in "fixed drug eruption" after NSAIDs can also cause, and "allergic" or "reaction" in "chance of an allergic reaction" in vaccine side-effect text.

modes.label: Fixed drug eruption
modes.description: The word "fixed" right before "drug eruption" in a list of NSAID skin reactions.
modes.example: NSAIDs can also cause<< fixed>> drug eruption (FDE). FDE

modes.label: Allergic reaction after vaccine
modes.description: "allergic" or the following "reaction" in a vaccine side-effect sentence.
modes.example: there is a small chance of an<< allergic>> reaction. A few people have reported health

card.writes: It seems to hold back immune-related words such as immune, antigen and antibody as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word that begins a named drug or vaccine reaction, like "fixed" drug eruption or "allergic" reaction.
